node_numbering.description: Node (ix,iy) has index iy*(nelx+1)+ix. ix in [0,nelx], iy in [0,nely]. y=0 is bottom, y=nely is top. Node n has DOFs [2*n, 2*n+1] for (ux, uy).

element_numbering.description: Element (ex,ey) has index ey*nelx+ex. ex in [0,nelx-1], ey in [0,nely-1]. Element nodes: BL=(ex,ey), BR=(ex+1,ey), TR=(ex+1,ey+1), TL=(ex,ey+1).

output.density_layout: density[i,j] = physical density of element (ex=j, ey=i), ey=0 is bottom row
